rationale: manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=six-box manduca_bilateral iter-5 (CONFIRMATION). (a) LEVER MAP: iter-1 proj_sr=1.5 hr=0.059819 (base); iter-2 proj_sr=3.0 hr=0.059785 FLAT; iter-3 bf_d_w_ratio 1/6->0.5 (proj spatial sigma 0.83px->2.5px) hr=0.059831 FLAT+hr-best; iter-4 img_n_bf 1->2 hr=0.007072 REGRESSED (image-domain capacity over-smoothed, -0.053). Both proj-domain bilateral axes (range proj_sr, spatial bf_d_w_ratio) are flat to <1.2e-4; the only image-domain capacity lever collapsed. (b) CEILING IS FIRM at hr~=0.0598: the unexplored named lever manduca_N0 is NOT a wired config key (grep of every cluster *.py finds no N0/manduca_N0 consumer and no manduca solver file -> patching it is a guaranteed no-op), and epochs cannot move a ~7-param wrapper that already converged to hr 0.0598 +/- 6e-5 across three independent 387-563s runs. The solver is a cosmetic ~7-param bilateral around an already-strong truncation-corrected FBP; the FBP, not the bilateral, sets the ceiling. (c) PICK: empty-patch-style CONFIRMATION toward iter-20, carrying the iter-3 hr-best state (bf_d_w_ratio=0.5) so the confirm reproduces the 0.0598 operating point. (d) BUDGET: ~563s at iter-3, comfortably inside the hard 20-min budget. (e) BASE_ITER=3 (hr-best 0.0598308)., bf_d_w_ratio=0.5
